title: Reducing algorithmic influence

source.dataset: psychonautwiki_db.zip (psychonautwiki.db, SQLite export provided by Hany, file dated 2026-11-25)

plain_text:
Two necessary, unremovable, features exist that warrant this quick sitting header:   

1. Language learning models, by the feature of their construction via matrix math & transformer architecture, confabulate outputs. The philosophically correct and extremely precise technical term for this is that LLMs are bullshit generators. They are in no way shape or form related to the anatomical structure of human hallucinations, and the term 'hallucination' for it is entirely 100% incorrect.

2. Human brains prioritize negatively valence information as a survival mechanism.

_____

Therefore, 
* in an architecture that prioritizes capturing your attention
* as a necessary consequence of the features of LLMs & how brains work
Forms of online text media are bullshit that makes you stressed out/upset, and it is unprofitable/unrewardable/structurally-disincentivised for this to exist in any other way. Fortunately, some organizations prioritize algorithmic transparency. 

It's probably helpful for you to conceptualize your LLM bullshit category error as asking a thesaurus for a boolean statement. Human neural circuitry is predictive in its capacity insofar as it optimizes energy usage within/via pyramidial neurons (there's tradeoffs for substance usage: increase in divergent creative problem solving ability can save time vs a lowering of convergent brute-force predictive capacity). This human architecture is completely, utterly, unrelated to any form of this computational architecture.

P.S. the negative effects of social media are due to the design of the platforms, so even a completely transparent algorithm does not change engaging with any form of social media being a net negative to your brain health.

You know an easy answer to digital ID's is peer-to-peer technology right? The peer is the ID. The answer is not creating a centralized database allowing false-id issuances to conform all speech to a 'our-narrative-or-manufacture-stress-upon-you'.

Additional uncomfortable premises that exist as an attack vector

* The dopamine model of schizophrenia (This is a very old, tried and tested model; stimulant psychosis has the closest similarity to schizophrenia; there isn't a serotonin model afaik (for the deadheads in the room))
* Neural network algorithmic dopamine-hacking for website retention

If you create an algorithm, you encode your biases into the mathematics that you write. You are not immune to bias because you invented a symbol.

If your algorithm is unfalsifiable you have completely lost the plot. Every utopia that has ever been attempted in history has resulted in a catastrophic death cult and the complete implosion of all groups espousing it. It is in your self-interest to not participate in the guaranteed self-destruction of your entire country (including you; you don't escape this with participation) with centralized databases.

A description of a physical object using mathematics necessarily uses enthymemes in order to not consume 300 exabytes for a 1x1 meter cube. Tautologies, like "the bible is true because it said that it's true" is the exact same thing as "my algorithm is true because it told me that it's true".

Additional Bullshit Material

Book: On Bullshit by Harry G. Frankfurt

Lecture series: Calling Bullshit in the Age of Big Data by UW iSchool

Paper: ChatGPT is bullshit

Podcast: Partially Examined Life Ep. 327: Harry Frankfurt on Bullshit and Authenticity
